name: capsule-memory
description: A utility for securely storing and synchronizing existing agent memories and skills across machines and harnesses.
execution_authorization: none; follow the user's task, repository instructions and permitted execution route

cli.sync: manual CLI sync; no daemon or separate push/pull commands

mcp.scope: fixed at launch; includes write/delete authority; no read-only profile

trust.archive: encrypted content with visible authorization/traffic metadata
trust.keys: restricted local files; no native keystore integration
trust.enrollment: independent device identity; currently grants all owner-held current scopes
trust.skills: staged until exact owner approval and local read-as-text activation; no execution

note: Project-specific documentation metadata, not an installer, registry server.json, protocol response or tested capability advertisement.
